ValidationRule.description: Restricts the Opportunities movement from Develop
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: And( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName),"Develop") , ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Design"), OR(ISBLANK( Description),ISBLANK(Status_Update__c),ISBLANK( contact_role_count__c),ISBLANK( Product_Count__c )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill Description ,status update, add at least one Contact Role and at least one Product on opportunity before going to next Stages.
